categories.main_business_segments: KOKUSAI ELECTRIC operates a single business segment focused on the manufacturing, sales, and servicing of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The business is further divided into equipment (batch deposition and single-wafer treatment systems) and service (maintenance, parts, upgrades, and legacy equipment sales) units.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include advanced batch Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), Low Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LP-CVD), and thermal processing (annealing, oxidation, diffusion) for semiconductor front-end manufacturing. Proprietary batch ALD technology enables high productivity and high-quality thin film formation, while single-wafer plasma and annealing tools provide advanced film treatment and curing solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: KOKUSAI ELECTRIC primarily serves major global semiconductor device manufacturers, with key customers including CXMT, Samsung Electronics, and TSMC. Its equipment is used in the production of DRAM, NAND, Logic/Foundry, and power devices, targeting applications in memory, logic, and sensor markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, with major sales in China, Taiwan, South Korea, the United States, Japan, and other Asian and European regions. It maintains manufacturing and service subsidiaries in Japan, Korea, China, Taiwan, the US, Germany, and Singapore.
categories.supply_chain_position: KOKUSAI ELECTRIC is positioned as an upstream supplier in the semiconductor value chain, providing critical process equipment for the front-end wafer fabrication stage to semiconductor manufacturers (fabs).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in high-value-added products, especially batch ALD and treatment technologies for advanced and 3D device structures. The company is expanding R&D for next-generation batch and single-wafer platforms, strengthening global development and demo capabilities, and investing in digital transformation (DX) and ESG initiatives. It also aims to diversify applications into power devices, mature nodes, and sensors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and recurring service revenues from maintenance, parts, upgrades, and legacy equipment. Service business provides stable, high-margin recurring income, while equipment sales are subject to semiconductor capital investment cycles.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include global semiconductor equipment makers such as Applied Materials and Lam Research. KOKUSAI ELECTRIC holds the world’s top market share in batch ALD and plasma gate modification tools, maintaining a strong competitive position in high-productivity batch processing for memory and logic applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated revenue was 238.9 billion yen, with operating profit of 51.3 billion yen and net profit of 36.0 billion yen. The company has demonstrated significant growth, with revenue nearly doubling since FY2019, and maintains a strong profit margin and robust cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KOKUSAI ELECTRIC differentiates itself through its industry-leading batch ALD technology, which uniquely combines high productivity with high-quality film formation for complex 3D device structures. Its solutions address both advanced technical requirements and cost efficiency, offering customers superior throughput, reliability, and process performance across the equipment lifecycle.
